_readme: The queued mutation types, ONE list for three copies: packages/core/src/schemas/mutations.ts MUTATION_TYPES, apps/operator/src/lib/mutate.ts DIRECT_RPC and functions/replay/index.ts MUTATION_RPCS. replay asserts against this file at boot (a mismatch fails the deploy); apps/operator/src/lib/mutate.test.ts asserts DIRECT_RPC and MUTATION_TYPES against it. Deno cannot import the core package, so this JSON is the shared artefact (PHASE-2 criticals, C4). pinGatedRpcs: the RPCs the replay function must verify_manager_pin for before dispatching (0115); mirrors packages/core PIN_GATED_RPCS.
